item.title: With Amit Shah in Guwahati, Assam BJP Locks NDA Path for Assembly Polls
item.description: Assam Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) president Dilip Saikia on Friday welcomed Union Home Minister Amit Shah at the state party headquarters, Atal Bihari Vajpayee Bhawan, in Guwahati’s Basistha area. Shah arrived after concluding his programme for the day in Assam’s Dibrugarh and Dhemaji. item.title: Assam: Heroin Worth Rs 5 Crore Seized, 1 Held in Silchar
item.description: In a major drug haul, heroin worth several crores was seized by the police during an operation at a residence in Assam’s Cachar district on Friday. The police also detained one individual in connection with the matter. The Silchar police searched a rented house located at Meherpur MHC Lane, based on a tip-off, officials informed. item.title: Three Lives Lost in Separate Road Accidents in Assam
item.description: A young motorcyclist was killed in a hit-and-run incident in Assam’s Silchar on Friday, triggering public anger and a brief road blockade. The accident took place near Rangpur Clock Tower on the Silchar–Imphal National Highway. The victim has been identified as Pradip Dhar, a resident of Salganga in Udharbond area in Cachar district. item.description: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has openly expressed discomfort and frustration over his country’s heavy dependence on foreign loans, saying repeated appeals for financial aid have become a matter of shame and have hurt Pakistan’s self-respect. item.title: Four Assam Youths Found Dead in a Room in Bengaluru
item.description: Four youths from Assam were allegedly found dead under mysterious circumstances in a single room in Bengaluru. According to sources, the youths had gone to Bengaluru for work and were staying together. The bodies were recovered from the same room, though the exact cause of death is yet to be confirmed.
